title: Factorial (Safe)
description: Write a factorial function that handles all inputs correctly including zero, negative numbers, and large numbers like 1000.
instructions: Implement factorial so it returns n! for non-negative integers, returns -1 for negative inputs, and handles large inputs without crashing.
hints: First handle the special cases: what should happen for negative numbers?
factorial(0) is defined as 1 by convention.
Python integers can be arbitrarily large so you don't need to worry about overflow for large inputs like 1000.
